 x.denied<130||x.readOnlyPlans<5||x.proposalPlans<3||

 x.hostedStatus!=='HOSTED_NO_GO')
 throw Error('V171M_STAGING_SECURITY_ACCEPTANCE_FAILED');

 qaStatus:'V171M_SYNTHETIC_SECURITY_QA_PASSED',
